summary: METPARK, Bordeaux Métropole's own parking authority, runs about thirty car parks, and the Métropole council approved in principle that it take over the Camille Jullian car park when that concession ends in September 2026. Bordeaux Métropole's mobility reports show hourly use of METPARK hypercentre car parks down 2% in 2024 and 3% in 2025, while TBM transit validations rose. The ZFE low-emission zone was due to start on 1 January 2025, a 30% on-street surcharge for heavy cars was announced from May 2025, and from early August 2026 Bordeaux introduced a single paid zone, 30 free minutes a day and 2 free weekend hours in six METPARK car parks.

items.text: METPARK is Bordeaux Métropole's own parking authority, a public body with its own legal personality and financial autonomy, set up in 2004 under the name Parcub. It runs about thirty car parks, and its statutes give it all of the Métropole's public car parks except those let out under public-service concessions.
items.source_title: Parc de stationnement - Camille Jullian - Choix du mode de gestion - Décision - Autorisation (Délibération n° 2025-443, Conseil de Bordeaux Métropole du 26 septembre 2025)

items.text: A report on Métropole car parks presented to the council said they had 16,384 car spaces in 2023. METPARK ran 29 sites (11,849 spaces) and concession holders ran 5 sites (3,693 spaces). Hourly (non-subscriber) use in 2023 was 3.62% lower than in 2022, and total revenue was over EUR 36 million.
items.source_title: Dossier de presse - Conseil de Métropole - 6 décembre 2024

items.text: The METPARK car park at Front du Médoc has been closed since 28 November 2023, when an emergency safety order required shoring of corroded beams. In July 2025 the Métropole council authorised pursuing acquisition of the pedestrian deck above it, subject to the co-owners' agreement, and studies of repair works; the provisional budget, excluding repairs to the car park itself, is estimated at EUR 15 million over 4-5 years and may change considerably.
items.source_title: Traitement stratégique des zones de stationnement et espaces publics de l'îlot Front du Médoc - Décision - Autorisation (Délibération n° 2025-319, Conseil de Bordeaux Métropole du 11 juillet 2025)

items.text: The METPARK Gambetta car park reopened on 28 November 2024 after being closed for 10 months for works.
items.source_title: Baromètre des mobilités Bordeaux Métropole - Bilan annuel 2024

items.text: The renovated Gambetta car park (reported cost EUR 7.8 million) has 438 car spaces, 102 of them with EV charging. It uses ticketless entry and exit based on number-plate recognition, plus a guidance system with signs that show free spaces in real time.
items.source_title: A historic parking lot in Bordeaux reopens its doors with 500 new parking spaces!

items.text: The 1989 concession under which Central Parc (Indigo group) runs the 336-space Camille Jullian underground car park ends on 1 September 2026, and the Métropole council approved in principle that METPARK take it over from 2 September 2026, with transfer terms to be set in a later decision. In 2024 it recorded about 109,400 hourly exits and revenue of EUR 1.07 million excluding tax.
items.source_title: Parc de stationnement - Camille Jullian - Choix du mode de gestion - Décision - Autorisation (Délibération n° 2025-443, Conseil de Bordeaux Métropole du 26 septembre 2025)

items.text: METPARK awarded TotalEnergies a 15-year concession to install and run 1,500 charge points in 26 METPARK car parks, with the first points to supply power from summer 2024. Most are 7 kVA points, with 22 fast (50 kW) and 18 high-power (200 kW) chargers, and parking is to be free for fast-charging sessions under 30 minutes.
items.source_title: TotalEnergies to Install 1,500 EV Charge Points in METPARK Parking Lots in Bordeaux

items.text: Bordeaux Métropole's 2025 mobility report counted 958 publicly accessible charge points in car parks (public and other), out of 2,877 publicly accessible charge points in the area.
items.source_title: Baromètre des mobilités Bordeaux Métropole - Bilan annuel 2025

items.text: Bordeaux Métropole's low-emission zone (ZFE) was due to come into force on 1 January 2025 inside the ring road, banning only vehicles with no Crit'Air rating, about 2.1% of the local fleet (around 11,000 vehicles). Eleven park-and-ride sites were to stay reachable for these vehicles, and a 24-hour ZFE pass can be used up to 24 times a year.
items.source_title: Dossier de presse - Conseil de Métropole - 6 décembre 2024

items.text: France's Constitutional Council struck out the article of the national simplification law that would have abolished ZFE low-emission zones, on procedural grounds. As a result, ZFEs remain legally in force in the areas that have them. The source does not mention Bordeaux specifically.
items.source_title: ZFE : le Conseil constitutionnel relance le débat et annule leur suppression

items.text: In January 2025 Bordeaux announced a 30% higher on-street parking rate from 2 May for petrol and diesel cars over 1,600 kg and hybrid or electric cars over 1,900 kg. It applies to hourly rates and subscriptions, but professionals' subscriptions are exempt.
items.source_title: Hausse du tarif de stationnement des véhicules particuliers les plus lourds : Bordeaux emboîte le pas à Paris

items.text: From early August 2026, Bordeaux replaced its red and green on-street zones with a single paid zone. Charging moved from quarter-hours to half-hours, and every vehicle gets 30 free minutes once a day. Listed rates for standard cars run from EUR 1.90 for 45 minutes to EUR 20 for 4 hours. Residents' parking was not changed.
items.source_title: La politique de stationnement évolue pour les visiteurs : courte durée, week-ends…

items.text: As part of the same reform, six METPARK car parks on the edge of the centre offer 2 free hours on Saturdays and Sundays: Amédée-Saint-Germain, Amplitude, Beaujon, Grand Parc, Paludate and Porte de Bordeaux. Together they have about 2,500 spaces.
items.source_title: La politique de stationnement évolue pour les visiteurs : courte durée, week-ends…

items.text: Bordeaux's parking FAQ says on-street parking is paid from 9:00 to 19:00 except on Sundays and public holidays. It lists residents' rates of EUR 1 per 24 hours, EUR 6 per week, EUR 10 per two weeks and EUR 15 per month.
items.source_title: Vos questions sur le stationnement à Bordeaux

items.text: A press report says Bordeaux Métropole plans to raise TBM fares by an average of 3% in 2027, after average rises of 3.2% in 2023, 3.6% in 2024 and 3% in 2025. Under the plan, the park-and-ride fare goes from EUR 4.50 to EUR 5.
items.source_title: C'est officiel, les prix des tickets de trams et de bus vont encore augmenter à Bordeaux en 2027

items.text: In 2024, hourly (non-subscriber) exits at six city-centre METPARK car parks fell 2% from 2023, and subscriber use also fell. Over the same year, TBM transit validations rose 9% and road traffic in the Métropole, excluding the ring road, fell 2%.
items.source_title: Baromètre des mobilités Bordeaux Métropole - Bilan annuel 2024

items.text: In 2025, hourly exits at eight city-centre METPARK car parks fell 3% from 2024; the report says hourly use of these car parks is down 37% over several years. Non-resident subscribers fell 8% and resident subscribers 4%, while TBM validations rose 3%.
items.source_title: Baromètre des mobilités Bordeaux Métropole - Bilan annuel 2025

items.text: The city's magazine reported that Bordeaux's pedestrian area grew from 172 to 259 hectares over five years. Footfall on central shopping streets in December 2024 was 15% higher than in December 2023.
